The edit needs your approval to write to `src/components/ErrorBoundary.tsx`. Once approved, here's a summary of what changed vs. the existing file: | | Before | After | |---|---|---| | `fallback` prop | `ReactNode` (static) | `(error, reset) => ReactNode` (render prop — caller controls retry button) | | Error logging | `console.error(error, componentStack)` | Structured object with `message`, `stack`, `componentStack` | | External logging | None | `onError?: (error, info) => void` callback (for Sentry etc.) | | Component stack in UI | Captured but never shown | Shown in a collapsible `
` element | | Retry button | Always shown in default UI | Shown in default UI; also passed to custom `fallback` via render prop | Usage examples: ```tsx // Default fallback UI with retry // Custom fallback with access to error and retry (

Oops: {err.message}

)}> // With external error reporting Sentry.captureException(err, { extra: info })}> ```
